failure: Failure: No implication is claimed for approximate/additive norm evaluation, norm-zero testing, randomized polynomial identity testing, or general identity testing. The reported finite exact checker is not run by this intake.
interface: Interface: The oracle returns the exact rational/integer expectation with all output bits. The reduction makes polynomially many queries to circuits of polynomial size and degree over independent standard real Gaussians. It is a Turing reduction, not one-query or approximate evaluation.

claims.title: Exact standard-Gaussian squared-norm evaluation is #P-hard for integer arithmetic circuits
